verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents some admin-side sharing controls: a Rules Engine of admin automation workflows for meeting access and privacy, team privacy settings (implied by Super Admin's ability to bypass them), audit logs, and per-meeting sharing to email recipients with optional expiry. Moving meetings into channels/folders shows folder organization, but no folder-level permissions are documented. missing for 10: evidence of private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permission levels, audit logs or admin reporting shown to cover what is shared, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
